777-2363-4659-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Foundry Inspector, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

323-4279-6887--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
323-4279-6887--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4460-4770-6090-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7659-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7659-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

147-4875-8198.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Trystan's Command
147-4875-8198.description:
Cast Trystan's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Trystan's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Trystan's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-4875-8198.notes: When choosing modes, the other mode you choose will net additional results.

4613-4968-5338.easyPrerequisites:
Francisco has a +1/+1 counter on it.
The top card of your library isn't a land card.
Deathbringer Thoctar is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
4613-4968-5338.description:
Activate Francisco by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Francisco triggers, revealing the top card of your library, then putting it back on top and putting a +1/+1 counter on Francisco.
Repeat.

1874-1981-2415-5231.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1874-1981-2415-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

833-1059-3257-3827.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace, Grand Warlord Radha, and at least three additional creatures you control can attack without taking damage.
833-1059-3257-3827.description:
Declare Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Grand Warlord Radha and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Grand Warlord Radha trigger, adding at least five mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Rakdos Carnarium from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Rakdos Carnarium, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2724-3080-5299-7843.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Elrond by paying {5}{U}{U}, exiling and returning (at end step) Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

1090-1895-5998-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1619-2921-4605-5542-6143.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6143.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Feywild Caretaker from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Feywild Caretaker.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Feywild Caretaker token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Feywild Caretaker that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6143.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1619-2034-4605-5542-6149.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6149.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Stirring Bard from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Stirring Bard enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Stirring Bard.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Stirring Bard token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Stirring Bard token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Stirring Bard trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6149.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

3249-5147-5173-5542.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

1978-5089-7685.description:
Animate Arc Reactor using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate Arc Reactor by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arc Reactor.
Repeat from step 2.

2719-7546-7683.notablePrerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 or higher.
2719-7546-7683.description:
Cast a copy of Maestro's Gift by paying {3}{U}{R}, targeting Inspired Skypainter.
Maestro's Gift's storm ability triggers, copying it for each spell cast before it this turn. Choose to have each copy target Prismari.
Resolve the first copy of Maestro's Gift targeting Prismari, creating a token copy of Prismari with haste.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining copy of Maestro's Gift that targets Prismari.
Resolve the final copy of Maestro's Gift, creating a token copy of Inspired Skypainter with haste. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Cast a copy of Maestro's Gift by paying {3}{U}{R}, targeting Inspired Skypainter.
Maestro's Gift will have a storm ability for each Prismari you control, and each storm ability will trigger.
Resolve the first storm trigger, copying Maestro's Gift for each spell cast before it this turn. Choose to have each copy target Prismari.
Repeat step 3 for each copy created in step 8.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 for each remaining storm trigger from step 7.
Repeat from step 5 as mana allows.
2719-7546-7683.notes: The listed mana cost is a suggested cost - you may use less mana, but you'll get less tokens. You can also compensate for less mana by having a higher storm count. It isn't required for each Maestro's Gift to copy Prismari, but doing so will net you more storm triggers the next iteration. On the last iteration, you can target whatever creature(s) you desire.

933-3258-7417.description:
If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Blink Sanar using Conjurer's Closet. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
933-3258-7417.notes: If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

4659-5365-5494-7315.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
4659-5365-5494-7315.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

1171-1409-4785.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

2092-4131-7170.description:
Cause Basalt Monolith to become a creature using Living Brain.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying at most {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1818-5010-6798-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-5010-6798-6900.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

662-1597-1978.description:
Cause Gyre Sage to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gyre Sage.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-3488-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1978-3488-4002.description:
Animate Sceptre of Eternal Glory using Katsumasa.
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat from step 2.

4691-5919-6922.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
4691-5919-6922.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Vilis and causing you to draw a card.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 4 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library, or from having 0 life.

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Steward of the Harvest

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness

145-5090-6474.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven enchantments.
145-5090-6474.description:
Activate the creature with Singing Bell Strike attached using Serra's Sanctum's ability by tapping it, adding at least seven {W}.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.

339-677-6791-6797.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3652-5220-5683-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Ornithopter and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat.

654-678-3967-6644.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

372-3603-4125.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Cloudshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Shipwreck Dowser exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
372-3603-4125.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Shipwreck Dowser and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Shipwreck Dowser trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Shipwreck Dowser and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

719-1494-5974.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Numa triggers, causing you to pay {10} to put five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

751-1741-3664-5914.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional land that can tap to produce {U}

290-304-1978.description:
Animate Dreamstone Hedron using Tough Cookie.
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Repeat from step 2.

2499-3484-4374.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
2499-3484-4374.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

2871-4050-5851.manaNeeded: {9}{R}{R}{R} at most, depending on how many Stormsplitters you control
2871-4050-5851.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving target creature +3/+0 until end of turn, and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
If you control at least 8 Stormsplitters, activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Stormsplitter tokens, adding {3}{R}.
Repeat.
If you have an additional {3}{R} available and/or control additional Stormsplitter tokens, this combo will result in infinite Stormsplitter tokens and infinite colored mana.

4050-5660-5758.description:
Cast Sunshower Druid by paying {G}.
When Sunshower Druid enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sunshower Druid, adding {G}.
Resolve the Sunshower Druid trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness and causing you to gain 1 life.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Sunshower Druid from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

654-864-1541-2034-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Eternal Witness on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Eternal Witness from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating seven tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Eternal Witness and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers seven times and Eternal Witness triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

849-1039-3358.notablePrerequisites:
Hell's Caretaker does not have summoning sickness.
It is your upkeep step.
849-1039-3358.description:
During your upkeep, activate Teardrop Kami by sacrificing it, targeting Hell's Caretaker.
When Teardrop Kami dies, Anax triggers, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Resolve the Teardrop Kami trigger, untapping Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping it and sacrificing the Satyr, returning Teardrop Kami from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

147-554-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-554-4050.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1235-1872-1953-2011.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, creating a token copy of Composite Golem with haste.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token, then causing each token you control to become a copy of the Composite Golem token.
Activate the Myr by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

1209-2034-2302-4215.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kozilek, adding {C}{C}.
Kozilek and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Kozilek trigger, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Kozilek, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Repeat.

3664-4222-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Tidewater Minion.
3664-4222-4644.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.

531-651-4046.description:
Activate Outrider en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve Outrider en-Kor's ability, causing the next one damage dealt to Outrider en-Kor this turn to be dealt to Task Force instead.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Severed Strands by paying {1}{B} and sacrificing Task Force, causing you to gain life equal to Task Force's toughness and destroy target creature an opponent controls.
